entries.name: Pikachu
entries.label: Raids — Saturday — Costume — Normal
entries.source_text: Blast off with Astronaut Pikachu during World Space Week! This new costumed Pokemon makes its Pokemon GO debut in raids and free Timed Research.

entries.name: Pikachu
entries.label: Raids — Saturday — Costume — Normal
entries.source_text: Shiny Astronaut Pikachu will be available when the costume debuts. If you're lucky, you might encounter one in raids or from Timed Research!

entries.name: Pikachu
entries.label: Raids — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: Astronaut Pikachu will appear for the first time in Pokemon GO! Encounter it in one-star raids or through free Timed Research during this event.

entries.name: Pikachu
entries.label: Raids — Saturday — Shiny
entries.source_text: Astronaut Pikachu will appear in one-star raids. If you're lucky, you might encounter a Shiny one!

entries.name: Pikachu
entries.label: Timed Research — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: Free Timed Research will be available during the event. Complete the tasks to earn an encounter with Astronaut Pikachu and other rewards.
